title: AlphaGeometry Solves Olympiad Geometry at Near-Gold Level Without Human Proofs
whyItMatters: Solved 25 of 30 International Mathematical Olympiad geometry problems from purely synthetic proof data, proving neuro-symbolic AI can invent creative auxiliary constructions.
summary: Google DeepMind trained a neural language model from scratch on 100 million synthetically generated geometric theorems—with zero human proof demonstrations—and paired it with a symbolic deduction engine. AlphaGeometry solved 25 of 30 IMO geometry problems (vs. 10 for the prior state of the art), produced human-readable machine-verified proofs, and even discovered a generalized version of a 2004 IMO theorem.
technicalHighlights: Generated 100 million synthetic training proofs via symbolic traceback, overcoming extreme scarcity of formalized math data.
Solved 25/30 IMO geometry benchmark problems, approaching the average human IMO gold medalist score (25.9).
Every proof is mechanically checked by the symbolic deduction engine and readable by human olympiad graders.
caveats: Scoped specifically to Euclidean plane geometry; generalizing beyond geometry required the formal Lean 4 synthesis architecture introduced months later in AlphaProof.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrated that synthetic data + neuro-symbolic search unlocks creative mathematical auxiliary constructions.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly paved the way for AlphaProof, IMO 2025 gold systems, and modern Lean autoformalization loops.
scoreRationale.verification: Published in Nature with 100% symbolically verified proofs and open-source code.
scoreRationale.velocity: Jumped Olympiad geometry benchmark performance from 10/30 to 25/30 in a single architectural leap.
